text:
elena (prod): FYI — FinSight submitted a request to run Ark-30B in our Private deployment. They want INT8 quant, VPC, and p95 latency <=50ms for chat workloads. Can we triage quickly?

maya (ml-eng): Quick q: do they need full FP16 parity? or is small quality delta acceptable? Also need model files + tokenizer sample.

elena (prod): They said tolerable quality drop <=1% on our semantic-sim metric. Will share sample prompts and dataset later today.

sam (infra): For Private we need to size Dedicated capacity. Ark-30B INT8 might fit on A10G x2 or T4x4 depending on sequence length. Who owns perf tests?

ravi (bench): I'll bench. Need the model artifact (gguf/pt) and a sample prompt set + max_seq. If we test locally:
```
model: ark-30b
format: gguf
quant: int8
batch: 1
max_seq: 1024
threads: 8
```
Send me the artifact link and I'll run latency/throughput + quality eval.

maya (ml-eng): Important: check tokenizer compatibility (some Ark variants use a slightly different bpe). Also confirm whether we can use post-training static quant (PTQ) vs QAT. PTQ is faster but might show more degradation on instruction-following.

elena (prod): FinSight prefers fastest schedule — PTQ if quality stays in bounds. They want a two-week onboarding target.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-7689 — FinSight Ark-30B private onboarding. Owner: unassigned.

sam (infra): Blockers from infra: KMS key for customer data (we need policy), VPC peering checklist, and storage path for GGUF (S3 access role). Also need expected RPS estimate from product.

elena (prod): RPS estimate: peak 35rps, steady 8rps. Mostly short chat turns (~80 tokens).

ravi (bench): Ran a quick FP16 micro-run on a similar 30B yesterday — FP16 p95 ~110ms @batch1 on A10G. INT8 PTQ preliminary numbers show p95 ~65-80ms but quality hit ~0.6% on our sims. Will run full eval once artifact is up.

bench-bot: /bench start INF-7689 --model ark-30b --cfg "int8_ptq,batch1,seq1024"
bench-bot: results (prelim): p50 42ms, p95 72ms, tokens/sec 120. quality_delta: -0.6% (semantic-sim).

maya (ml-eng): That quality delta looks within FinSight's tolerance. Two things to verify: 1) no hallucination spike on instruction prompts, 2) degradation on long-context >1024.

sam (infra): For rollout plan: Private deployment -> Dedicated pool with cross-region fallback disabled. We should set canary 10% traffic, monitor latency/quality, then 100%. Ops needs 72h notice to provision GPUs if capacity gap.

elena (prod): Can we schedule provisioning now? target start next Tue.

sam (infra): I'll start capacity request but mark as tentative until bench completes.

maya (ml-eng): I'll kick off PTQ recipe: calibrate on their sample prompts + some internal instruction set. If PTQ fails, we try QAT but that'll add ~4-5 days.

ravi (bench): Checklist I'm using: [model artifact, tokenizer test, perf baseline FP16, PTQ run, eval on customer prompts, safety scan, regression alerts]. I'll attach results to INF-7689.

elena (prod): Owners: maya -> quant experiments; ravi -> perf + eval; sam -> infra provisioning & KMS/VPC; elena -> customer coord. Priority: P1 (enterprise).

maya (ml-eng): One more note: need to confirm license for Ark-30B weights (open vs restricted). Legal ok?

elena (prod): FinSight confirmed licensing clearance in email. I'll attach.

ravi (bench): ETA: first bench pass by EOD tomorrow. If all good, we can aim for canary next Wednesday.

sam (infra): Marking infra tasks: create service account, S3 role, KMS policy, private endpoint. Ops-bot updated.

ops-bot: INF-7689 updated: owners assigned -> maya, ravi, sam; status -> in_progress.

elena (prod): Thanks team. If bench numbers hold (p95 <=80ms INT8 and quality delta <=1%), we go forward with PTQ->private canary. Please post short summary in thread when bench done.

maya (ml-eng): Will do. Posting artifact link when uploaded: s3://redwood-private/arks/ark-30b/ark-30b.gguf

ravi (bench): Confirmed receipt of artifact. Starting runs now.

sam (infra): Logged capacity request CR-4412 (A10G x4 cluster). Expect ops approval in 48h.

elena (prod): Perfect. Closing out for now — will follow up after bench results. :thumbsup:
